description: This file defines functions for handling object IDs and hash conversions in a Git-related project, including parsing hexadecimal object IDs, converting between binary and hex representations, and supporting multiple hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal hash of specified algorithm from input string and writes the binary object ID.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using specified algorithm, reentrant version.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts object ID to hex string, reentrant version.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using specified algorithm, static buffer.

methods.name: oid_to_hex
methods.description: Converts object ID to hex string, static buffer.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hex object ID string into an object ID structure using specified algorithm.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects and parses object ID hex string into an object ID, for any supported algorithm.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects and parses object ID hex string into an object ID, for any supported algorithm.

methods.name: get_hash_hex
methods.description: Converts hex string to binary hash for the specified hash algorithm, if enabled.

methods.name: get_oid_hex
methods.description: Converts hex string to object ID, if enabled.

methods.name: hash_to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using the chosen hash algorithm.
